slots.name: Pax Silica signatories
slots.sentence: As a result of the summit, 10 new partners joined the initiative—Argentina, Chile, Costa Rica, El Salvador, the EU, Germany, Greece, Kazakhstan, the Netherlands, and Panama—bringing the total to 24 signatories.

slots.name: participating nations
slots.sentence: The summit produced a Joint Statement on AI Opportunity Partnership signed by the United States and 34 other nations, aligning on a pro-growth approach to AI.

slots.name: funding notice date
slots.sentence: After the second summit, the Bureau of Economic and Business Affairs posted a Notice of Funding Opportunity on July 1.
